title: Daily programme reminders, evening check-in and bedtime alert
summary: A three-reminder preset opens the full daily checklist, asks about completion in the evening and gives bedtime a separate high-priority Android channel.

changes.detail: Bedtime category, opt-in morning/evening/bedtime preset using wake/sleep preferences, category-aware navigation and full daily task checklist.
Clear Arabic, English and French reminder messages. Bedtime has high Android importance and optional sound/vibration; browser requests persistent display where supported.
Existing saved schedules migrate with bedtime disabled; unrelated lesson notifications and completion records are preserved.

validation.name: Verification pending
validation.detail: Tests and static checks pending. No phone delivery verification, APK rebuild or deployment. Alerts respect device settings and Do Not Disturb.
